{{SameName|Deep Freeze|[[Deep Freeze (Pre-MEGA)|Pre-MEGA]] • [[Deep Freeze (Village of Despair)|Village of Despair]] • [[Deep Freeze (Frost Invasion)|Frost Invasion]] • [[Deep Freeze|Modern]]}} {{EventSandboxOnly|date=the 4th of December 2021|event=[[Frost Invasion Event]]}} {{For|the [[Freezer/Gallery|{{Color|Premium|Deep Freeze}} Freezer]] skin}} {{Zombie |title1 = Deep Freeze |image-static = Deepfreezeoutpost.png |image-dynamic = DeepFreezeLegacyDynamic.png |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] via [[Logbooks]] ---- Originally:
[[Frost Invasion Event|Frost Invasion]] |first_wave_appearance = 12 (Originally) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]5,000 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Slow (2) |defense = {{Defense}}50% |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Freeze}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Deep Freeze''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] as part of the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. It can now only appear in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had a high amount of health, but walked slowly. It also had 50% [[defense]] which reduced most forms of damage. The '''Deep Freeze''' could not be frozen as it had [[Freeze Immunity]]. ==Appearance== The '''Deep Freeze''' has baby blue skin, and white snow textured torso and legs. A tumor can be seen on its head. White spikes can be seen coming out of its shoulders. White ice chunks can be seen sticking out of its arms and legs. Its head is slightly tilted downwards and had a twisted left leg. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] is listed instead. *You should use high DPS towers, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Turret]], to defeat the '''Deep Freeze'''. **However, be aware that due to the 50% [[defense]], it will take longer than normal to defeat the '''Deep Freeze'''. **You may want to use the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability to boost the firerate of these towers. *[[Defense]] is ignored by splash damage, meaning that towers and [[units]] that deal splash damage will do 100% damage if the '''Deep Freeze''' is caught in the epicenter. **This makes towers like the [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]] very useful against the '''Deep Freeze'''. **Upon collision, [[units]], like the [[Railgun Tank]], will ignore [[defense]] and deal full collision damage towards the '''Deep Freeze'''. *As the '''Deep Freeze''' has quite high defense, you can use a Level 2 [[Pyromancer]] to lower its defense, allowing your towers to deal more damage to it. **Additionally, as with all enemies in the [[Frost Invasion Event]], the [[Pyromancer]] deals double fire damage to the '''Deep Freeze''' (though normal damage is not doubled). **You can also use other defense dropping towers, like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Freezer]]. However, these are more expensive and less effective as they only drop 20% defense. *The '''Deep Freeze''' cannot be frozen by the [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] or [[Sledger]]. **If you want to slow the '''Deep Freeze''' down, then you must use the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Toxic Gunner]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyDeepFreeze.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Frost Invasion Trailer|'''Deep Freeze''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostInvasionDeepFreezeIconIG.png|'''Deep Freeze''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This version of the '''Deep Freeze''' was quite similar to the [[Deep Freeze (Village of Despair)|Deep Freeze]] from [[Village of Despair]] in appearance. **Another version of the [[Deep Freeze (Pre-MEGA)|Deep Freeze]] existed prior to the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]] that has since been removed, though that version looked very different to this version of the '''Deep Freeze'''. ==Update History== *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3]] **'''Deep Freeze''' added. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **'''Deep Freeze''' removed. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **'''Deep Freeze''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Deep Freeze]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. **{{Bug}} '''Deep Freeze''' has no health in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]], causing it to break. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0]] **No longer copies the statistics of the modern version in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **{{Bugfix}} '''Deep Freeze''' no longer breaks, as it now has health in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{FrostInvasion|[[Unstable Ice (Frost Invasion)|Unstable Ice]]|Wave 11|Deep Freeze|Wave 12|[[Frost Invader (Frost Invasion)|Frost Invader]]|Wave 14}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Deep Freeze}}
